The chance to roll a 6 is based on 2 values. The first value is equal to the higher value between 1 and TotalLuck+2. This value is then entered into a base-3
. The result is then multiplied by 1/6 for the final chance. Essentially, this chance will be 1/3 when the player reaches +600% Luck, 1/2 at +2400%, and guaranteed at +72600% Luck.
Since the result of 1 in a logarithm is always 0, Chula-Reh will normally not be able to roll a 6 while he is "Unlucky!", unless his Luck is relatively high outside of this state.
Rerollos are also made 5 times more common.
